svg.title: Memoria: how it works
svg.desc: A Claude Code session calls the memoria skill, which runs memory_store.py. The script saves per-day, per-project Markdown files and a decisions.jsonl log into the sessions folder of the project, and loads them back in three modes.
svg.text: persistent project memory for Claude Code
One Markdown file per day and project, a decisions log, and a script that refuses to lose data.

svg.text: The store belongs to the project folder, not to the skill: run the script with the project folder as the working directory.
save: what happens to a proposal
project name is a lowercase slug (not 'all')

svg.text: else: conflict, run load and retry
a stale lock is never removed
id from an earlier day: refused,
datetime bumped only on changed items
temp file in the same folder

svg.text: changed, revision, added / updated / unchanged, decisions {added, unchanged}
A save that changes nothing leaves both files byte-identical. Exit code 1 and error: ... on stderr when it refuses.

svg.text: A record replaced by a later one carries superseded_by.
--query keeps matching records only (never decisions) and drops files without a match. load never writes anything.

svg.text: one object per line · only the user's own decisions
identical save: no revision or datetime change
corrupt file or unknown schema: refused, kept
atomic writes, lock files, revision check
UTC clock; file date = date part of datetime
